module: OBSOLETE auxiliary controller (replaced by 'genericGauges') for the digital dashboard screen of the Wendover: HTML texture (1024 x jbeam height, 161 by default) fed with electrics values and a computed average fuel consumption.
usage: -- jbeam: controller "wendoverGauges" with materialName, htmlPath and optional height
notes: jbeam fields read: materialName, htmlPath (required), height (default 161). Without either one, updateGFX becomes nop. init writes an obsolescence error log.

Data sent ('updateData'): electrics.{signal_L, signal_R, lights, highbeam, lowfuel, parkingbrake, checkengine, hazard, oil, oiltemp, gear, rpmTacho, fuel, watertemp, engineRunning, wheelspeed, abs, absActive}, averageFuelConsumption, gearboxType (type of the first device of category gearbox, otherwise 'none').

Instantaneous consumption = (previous fuelVolume - fuelVolume) / (dt * wheelspeed) * 1000 * 100 bounded to 0..100; the average is only accumulated if wheelspeed > 1.4 m/s and is bounded to 0..50. It uses electrics.values.fuelVolume (written elsewhere).
Refresh: texture at 8 FPS, data updated at most every 0.1 s, only if a player is seated and if obj:getUpdateUIflag() is true.

init.desc: Called at initialization: creates the HTML texture and determines the gearbox type.

reset.desc: Called at reset; does nothing (the consumption counters are not reset).

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: sends the dashboard values to the HTML texture about 10 times per second.
